name: MIKACIN 750mg Injection 3ml
introduction:
Introduction About MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION

MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION contains Amikacin which belongs to a group of medicines called Aminoglycoside Antibiotic. It is used in the management of serious infections caused by the bacteria that are sensitive to amikacin such as respiratory tract and lung infections, gastrointestinal infections, inflammation of the inner lining of the heart, infected burns, or bacterial infections of the blood.

Prior to or during the management with MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION, your doctor might ask you take some diagnostic tests to check your kidney function, hearing and levels of MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION in your blood.

MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with myasthenia gravis (severe weakness of body muscles). Before receiving MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, hearing difficulty or tinnitus (ringing or buzzing in the ears), an antibiotic-related hearing loss or a mitochondrial mutation disease (a condition caused by variations in the mitochondrial genome).

MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if considered necessary. Contact your doctor before receiving it. Caution must be exercised while using MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION in premature or new-born infants.

MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients above the age of 60 years. Consult your doctor before receiving it. The most common side effects of receiving MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION are tinnitus (ringing in the ears), hearing problem, inner ear damage, decrease in excretion of urine. Consult your doctor if the symptoms do not resolve or worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION Works

MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION acts on the bacteria and disrupt the important life functions of the bacteria. It interferes with the present bacteria and disrupts the cell membrane along with hampering its various cellular function which leads to bacterial death. It also stops the further spread of the infection this way.
usageDetails:
How to use MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION

MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein or muscle as an intramuscular or intravenous injection or as infusion (drip). Your doctor will determine the correct dose and duration for you based upon your body weight, age and severity of disease condition.

warnings.details: MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant women only if considered necessary. Contact your doctor before receiving MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION.

MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION should be used with caution in breast feeding women only if considered necessary as it is not known if it is excreted into breast milk. Contact your doctor before receiving MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION.
Do not drive or operate machines, if you feel dizzy after receiving MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION.
MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Your doctor might monitor your kidney function. Consult your doctor before receiving MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION.
Do not receive MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to amikacin or any other aminoglycoside or allergic to sulphites or to other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Suffer from myasthenia gravis (severe weakness of body muscles)

Before receiving MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have tinnitus or difficulty hearing (ringing or buzzing in the ears)
Or any member of your family suffers from an antibiotic-related hearing loss
Or any member of your family have mitochondrial mutation disease (a condition caused by variations in the mitochondrial genome, the components of your cells that help make energy)

Use in paediatrics:

MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION should be used with caution in premature and new-born infants. Ask your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients. Your doctor might adjust your dose depending on your kidney function. Consult your doctor before receiving MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before receiving MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Diuretics (water tablets) such as furosemide and ethacrynic acid (used to get rid of fluid build-up in the body)
Indomethacin (used to reduce inflammation)
Other antibiotics such as penicillin, cephalosporins, gentamycin, tobramycin (used to manage certain infections)
Bisphosphonates such as alendronate (medicine used to manage bone mass loss)
Vitamin B1 (thiamine) (medicine used to metabolize carbohydrates, proteins, and fats)
Platinum compounds (metals used in chemotherapy) such as cisplatin, carboplatin, oxaliplatin
Muscle relaxants such as atracurium, rocuronium, vecuronium (used to relax muscles)
Anaesthetics such as methoxyflurane (used before surgery)

Overdosage:

MIKACIN 750MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, inform your doctor immediately if you experience any unusual symptoms.

The most common side effects of receiving MIKACIN 100MG INJECTION are tinnitus (ringing in the ears), hearing problem, inner ear damage, decrease in excretion of urine. Consult your doctor if the symptoms do not resolve or worsen.

AMBISTRYN S 0.75GM INJECTION contains Streptomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Aminoglycosides. AMBISTRYN S 0.75GM INJECTION should not be received by patients allergic to Streptomycin, and/or other aminoglycosides.

Before receiving AMBISTRYN S 0.75GM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have cranial (skull) nerve problems, vestibular nerve (responsible for motion and position) impairment, severe liver disease, and/or kidney problems (such as impaired kidney function, renal insufficiency, prerenal azotemia).

AMBISTRYN S 0.75GM INJECTION is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy since the medicine may cause ototoxicity (damage to the hearing/balance organs) in foetus. The medicine is advised to be received with caution by breast feeding women since the medicine may pass through breast milk.

AMBISTRYN S 0.75GM INJECTION should be administered with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be received with caution by elderly patients (aged 59-years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving AMBISTRYN S 0.75GM INJECTION are vestibular ototoxicity (associated with symptoms such as vomiting, nausea, internal spinning sensation), paraesthesia (prickling/tingling sensation) of face, fever, rash, red itchy welts, and/or eosinophilia (associated with symptoms such as rash, itching, asthma). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About AMIKAMAC 250MG INJECTION

AMIKAMAC 250MG INJECTION contains Amikacin which belongs to a group of medicines called Aminoglycoside Antibiotic. It is used in the management of serious infections caused by the bacteria that are sensitive to amikacin such as respiratory tract and lung infections, gastrointestinal infections, inflammation of the inner lining of the heart, infected burns, or bacterial infections of the blood.

Prior to or during the management with AMIKAMAC 250MG INJECTION, your doctor might ask you take some diagnostic tests to check your kidney function, hearing and levels of AMIKAMAC 250MG INJECTION in your blood.

AMIKAMAC 250MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with myasthenia gravis (severe weakness of body muscles). Before receiving AMIKAMAC 250MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have kidney problems, hearing difficulty or tinnitus (ringing or buzzing in the ears), an antibiotic-related hearing loss or a mitochondrial mutation disease (a condition caused by variations in the mitochondrial genome).

AMIKAMAC 250MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women only if considered necessary. Contact your doctor before receiving it. Caution must be exercised while using AMIKAMAC 250MG INJECTION in premature or new-born infants.

AMIKAMAC 250MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients above the age of 60 years. Consult your doctor before receiving it. The most common side effects of receiving AMIKAMAC 250MG INJECTION are tinnitus (ringing in the ears), hearing problem, inner ear damage, decrease in excretion of urine. Consult your doctor if the symptoms do not resolve or worsen.

AMIKAMAC 250MG INJECTION acts on the bacteria and disrupt the important life functions of the bacteria. It interferes with the present bacteria and disrupts the cell membrane along with hampering its various cellular function which leads to bacterial death. It also stops the further spread of the infection this way.

introduction:
Introduction About TOBAMIST XML RESPULE

TOBAMIST XML RESPULE contains Tobramycin which belongs to a group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used for the management of chronic chest infections in patients with cystic fibrosis caused by a bacteria called Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Cystic fibrosis is a life-threatening condition that damages the lungs and digestive tract caused by the bacteria called Pseudomonas aeruginosa. It is characterized by cough, repeated lung infections, weight gain and fatty stools.

Your doctor may test your hearing before starting or at any time during the management with TOBAMIST XML RESPULE. Always use TOBAMIST XML RESPULE exactly as directed by your doctor. Before using this medicine, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, heart problems, neuromuscular disorders and hearing problems. TOBAMIST XML RESPULE should be used with caution in pregnant women or if you are planning become pregnant and in breast-feeding woman. Discuss the risks and benefits with your doctor.

Safety and efficacy of this medicine have not been studied in paediatric patients below 6 years of age and in elderly patients above 65 years of age. Consult your doctor for advice. The common side effects are cough, ringing in ears and hoarseness. Consult your doctor if the side effects do not improve or worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About STREPTOMAC 1000MG INJECTION

STREPTOMAC 1000MG INJECTION contains Streptomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Aminoglycosides. STREPTOMAC 1000MG INJECTION is used to manage moderate to severe infections caused by susceptible strains of bacteria which includes tuberculosis infection (caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis bacteria) and non-tuberculosis infections (caused by Pasteurella pestis/ tularensis, brucella, H. ducreyi, Klebsiella granulomatis, and/or H. influenzae bacterium) in affected individuals.

STREPTOMAC 1000MG INJECTION should not be received by patients allergic to Streptomycin, and/or other aminoglycosides.

Before receiving STREPTOMAC 1000MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have cranial (skull) nerve problems, vestibular nerve (responsible for motion and position) impairment, severe liver disease, and/or kidney problems (such as impaired kidney function, renal insufficiency, prerenal azotemia).

STREPTOMAC 1000MG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy since the medicine may cause ototoxicity (damage to the hearing/balance organs) in foetus. The medicine is advised to be received with caution by breast feeding women since the medicine may pass through breast milk.

STREPTOMAC 1000MG INJECTION should be administered with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) and is advised to be received with caution by elderly patients (aged 59-years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving STREPTOMAC 1000MG INJECTION are vestibular ototoxicity (associated with symptoms such as vomiting, nausea, internal spinning sensation), paraesthesia (prickling/tingling sensation) of face, fever, rash, red itchy welts, and/or eosinophilia (associated with symptoms such as rash, itching, asthma). Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

How STREPTOMAC 1000MG INJECTION Works

STREPTOMAC 1000MG INJECTION works by binding to 30S and 50S ribosomes (intracellular structures made of RNA and protein in bacterial cell) and inhibits protein synthesis in bacterial cell which leads to errors in the transcription of the genetic code resulting in lysis/destruction of bacterial cell wall thus managing and managing the spread of infection in affected individuals.

STREPTOMAC 1000MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a muscle as an intramuscular injection, or into a vein as an intravenous injection/infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
